mapper.select: SELECT tp.* FROM training_program tp JOIN student_info s ON tp.major_id = s.major AND tp.start_year = s.year WHERE s.student_no = #{studentNo}

SELECT tc.id, tc.course_id, tc.course, tc.teacher_no, ct.weekday, ct.start_section, ct.end_section,
CONVERT(VARCHAR, ISNULL(cct.course_type, tc.course_type)) IFNULL(cct.course_type, tc.course_type) as course_type, ct.location FROM student_course_selection scs JOIN teacher_course tc ON scs.course_id = tc.course_id JOIN class_time ct ON scs.course_id = ct.course_id JOIN student_info s ON scs.student_no = s.student_no LEFT JOIN class_course_type cct ON tc.course_id = cct.course_id AND cct.class_id = s.class_name AND cct.year = s.year WHERE scs.student_no = #{studentNo}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN course_type = 1 AND study_status = 0 THEN course_credit ELSE 0 END), 0) as selectedCompulsory, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN course_type = 2 AND study_status = 0 THEN course_credit ELSE 0 END), 0) as selectedElective, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN course_type = 1 AND study_status = 2 THEN course_credit ELSE 0 END), 0) as completedCompulsory, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN course_type = 2 AND study_status = 2 THEN course_credit ELSE 0 END), 0) as completedElective FROM student_course_selection WHERE student_no = #{studentNo}

SELECT ct_exist.course_id FROM class_time ct_new JOIN student_course_selection scs ON scs.student_no = #{studentNo} JOIN class_time ct_exist ON scs.course_id = ct_exist.course_id WHERE ct_new.course_id = #{courseId} AND ct_new.weekday = ct_exist.weekday AND ct_new.start_section <= ct_exist.end_section AND ct_new.end_section >= ct_exist.start_section
ORDER BY ct_exist.course_id OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY
LIMIT 1
SELECT s.student_no as studentNo, cct.course_type as courseType FROM student_info s JOIN class_course_type cct ON s.class_name = cct.class_id AND s.year = cct.year WHERE cct.course_id = #{courseId}
